description: Human-readable interface record. Training reads the robot YAML and the selected training YAML, not this JSON. package_posttrain.yaml is the unified-prompt non-ECOT baseline; package_ecot_full.yaml adds ECOT supervision and full fine-tuning as described below.

layout.padding_note: 75 is the model padding limit, not the number of physical joints. Preserve the 16 raw dimensions in the order above.

actions.episode_boundary: Never query another episode. Mark out-of-bound horizon steps; current dataset behavior holds the final target.
actions.execution_horizon: A separate deployment choice; predicting 50 steps does not require executing all 50 before observing again.

requirements: Fit statistics after applying the robot mapping and arm state subtraction.
Record training source identities, dataset version and horizon with the statistics.
Use the same statistics for training, evaluation and deployment.
Do not reuse 25-step arm statistics for this 50-step contract.

task.instruction: Take out the top soft package from the box. Based on its initial label orientation in the box before grasping: if the label initially faces up, place the package directly on the conveyor belt; if it initially faces down, flip the package so the label faces up before placing it on the conveyor belt.
task.source: VLADataset.getdata: PACKAGE_TASK_PROMPT, adapted from branch-ecot with explicit pre-grasp orientation
task.policy: One instruction for all episodes, including those without annotation records. Both label orientations train together; orientation is inferred from observations.

annotations.usage: optional ECOT label supervision and source consistency checks; never used to select the prompt

ecot_full_finetuning.reference: local worktrees/branch-ecot, including action conditioning and visibility extensions
ecot_full_finetuning.normalization: bounds_99 using marked_9_1_0922/train_stats/norm_stats.json; overrides the baseline normalization above
ecot_full_finetuning.selection: annotated episodes only, both orientations, no regrasp exclusion
ecot_full_finetuning.null_bbox: negative visibility target; excluded from box regression
ecot_full_finetuning.action_condition: 11-dimensional differentiable prediction vector; no ground-truth targets supplied to action conditioning
ecot_full_finetuning.loss: L1 flow matching + 0.1 subtask CE + 0.05 visible-box Smooth L1 + 0.1 orientation CE + 0.1 visibility BCE
ecot_full_finetuning.trainable: vision encoder, VLM, action expert, projections, and all ECOT heads

fps.validation: Require finite positive FPS, camera video FPS consistency and timestamp spacing consistent with metadata. A different rate requires an explicit contract revision or documented resampling; do not silently assume 30.

identity.split_rule: All complete, cropped or reindexed versions of a source_episode_id must stay in one split.
identity.missing_identity: Resolve source provenance before splitting; a local episode_index is not a source identity.

alignment_checks: State and action vectors have 16 finite values in the specified order.
All three RGB streams correspond to the same observation timestamp.
Frame and global indices agree with episode boundaries and loaded row order.
